name: @oaknational/open-curriculum-ecosystem
description: Oak National Academy open curriculum data ecosystem - tools and services for working with the Oak Open Curriculum data
author: https://github.com/jimCresswell

scripts.sdk-codegen:refresh: SDK_CODEGEN_MODE=online turbo run --continue --force=true sdk-codegen && turbo run --continue build
scripts.docs-validators:check: pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-reference-direction && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-no-machine-local-paths && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-markdown-links && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-patterns-index && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-ratified-lists
scripts.repo-validators:check: pnpm --filter @oaknational/eslint-plugin-standards validate-boundaries && pnpm --filter @oaknational/oak-design-tokens validate-design-system-consistency && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-no-stale-script-invocations && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-collaboration-state && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-codex-team-alert-bootstrap && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-lifecycle-scripts && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-pretooluse-guard-routing && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-policy-reappraisal && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-claim-freshness && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-check-ci-parity && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-plan-corpus && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-workspace-config-isolation && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-identity-naming && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-notion-fence && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-mcp-content-current-source && pnpm --filter @oaknational/agent-tools validate-under-the-hood-content && pnpm --filter @oaknational/oak-design-showcase validate-authored-css && pnpm --filter @oaknational/oak-design-showcase validate-kit-assets && pnpm docs-validators:check
scripts.test:all: turbo run --continue test test:widget test:e2e test:ui test:a11y test:widget:ui test:widget:a11y
scripts.depcruise: depcruise apps packages agent-tools demos research/web-app-deconstruction/packages
scripts.depcruise:report: depcruise apps packages agent-tools demos research/web-app-deconstruction/packages --output-type dot > dependency-graph.dot
scripts.lint: turbo run --continue lint && pnpm lint:runtime-only && pnpm lint:shell
scripts.lint:shell:syntax: for f in apps/oak-curriculum-mcp-streamable-http/scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit "$?"; done && for f in .husky/pre-commit .husky/commit-msg .husky/pre-push .husky/pre-merge-commit .husky/prepare-commit-msg .husky/applypatch-msg .husky/pre-rebase .husky/refuse-commit-on-main.sh; do sh -n "$f" || exit "$?"; done
scripts.make: pnpm i && turbo run build type-check lint:fix && pnpm subagents:check && pnpm portability:check && pnpm practice:fitness:informational && pnpm markdownlint:root && pnpm format:root
scripts.re-build: pnpm clean && pnpm install && turbo run build
scripts.fix: pnpm format:root && pnpm markdownlint:root && pnpm lint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm secrets:scan && pnpm clean && turbo run --continue sdk-codegen build type-check lint test test:widget test:e2e test:ui test:a11y test:widget:ui test:widget:a11y && pnpm repo-validators:check && pnpm lint:runtime-only && pnpm lint:shell && pnpm subagents:check && pnpm portability:check && pnpm skills:check && pnpm encoding:check && pnpm knip:gate && pnpm depcruise && pnpm markdownlint-check:root && pnpm format-check:root
scripts.check:docs: pnpm format-check:root && pnpm markdownlint-check:root && pnpm docs-validators:check
scripts.fix:docs: pnpm format:root && pnpm markdownlint:root && pnpm docs-validators:check
scripts.update:playwright: pnpm install --save-dev -w @playwright/test@latest && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps
